memberdef.name: carr_deleteIndex

briefdescription.para: Deletes an element at a specified index.

detaileddescription.para: Removes the element at index from the vector.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the vector to modify.
Index of the element to delete.
Controls the deletion behavior, as defined by the implementation.

simplesect.para: CARR_VEC_OK if successful.
CARR_VEC_OutOfBounds if index is invalid.
CARR_VEC_NULL if a required pointer is NULL.
The meaning of fall and whether the removed element's pointer is freed must be verified in the implementation.

briefdescription.para: Destroys a vector and releases its internal resources.

detaileddescription.para: Releases resources owned by the vector implementation and invalidates the vector's internal storage.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the vector to destroy.

simplesect.para: This function does not return an error code.
Whether the structure is reset to a safe, reusable state depends on the implementation.
The pointed-to elements are not assumed to be freed.

detaileddescription.para: Creates a vector with the requested initial capacity and resizing mode.

parameterdescription.para: Whether the vector supports dynamic resizing.

simplesect.para: An initialized CARR instance.
Check the returned instance according to the implementation's initialization and allocation-failure conventions.

briefdescription.para: Appends an element to the end of the vector.

detaileddescription.para: Stores item after the current last element. Depending on the vector's configuration, the operation may require additional capacity.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the vector to modify.
Pointer to the element to append.

simplesect.para: CARR_VEC_OK if successful.
CARR_VEC_NULL if a required pointer is NULL.
CARR_VEC_ResizeError if the required resize cannot be performed.
CARR_VEC_OOM if memory allocation fails.

briefdescription.para: Inserts an element at the beginning of the vector.

detaileddescription.para: Stores item at index zero and shifts existing elements as necessary.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the vector to modify.
Pointer to the element to insert.

simplesect.para: CARR_VEC_OK if successful.
CARR_VEC_NULL if a required pointer is NULL.
CARR_VEC_ResizeError if the required resize cannot be performed.
CARR_VEC_OOM if memory allocation fails.

briefdescription.para: Replaces an element at a specified index.

detaileddescription.para: Assigns a new pointer to the element at idx.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the vector to modify.
Index of the element to replace.

simplesect.para: CARR_VEC_OK if successful.
CARR_VEC_OutOfBounds if idx is invalid.
CARR_VEC_NULL if a required pointer is NULL.
This function replaces the stored pointer. Ownership and cleanup of the previous element are determined by the implementation.

briefdescription.para: Changes the capacity of a vector.

detaileddescription.para: Requests a new capacity for the vector's underlying pointer array.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the vector to resize.

simplesect.para: CARR_VEC_OK if successful.
CARR_VEC_NULL if a required pointer is NULL.
CARR_VEC_ResizeError if resizing fails or is not permitted.
CARR_VEC_OOM if memory allocation fails.
The exact behavior when newCap is smaller than the current size depends on the implementation.

briefdescription.para: Reverses the order of elements in the vector.

detaileddescription.para: Reorders the stored pointers so that the first element becomes the last, the second becomes the second-to-last, and so on.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the vector to reverse.

simplesect.para: CARR_VEC_OK if successful.
CARR_VEC_NULL if a required pointer is NULL.
The elements themselves are not copied or modified; only their positions in the vector are changed.
